title: feat(usage): add billed token + experiment cohort fields to Usage API client
author: Monica Patel
release_notes: Usage API: surface billed token fields (billedPromptTokens, billedCompletionTokens, billedTokensTotal) alongside raw token fields.
Usage API: surface experiment attribution fields (experimentKey, experimentVariant, experimentCohort) when present in the API response.
No breaking changes: new fields are optional and default to undefined.
body: Context: Finance/RevOps + Product are analyzing Q1 pricing/packaging experiments and hardening metering. The backend Usage API now returns additional dimensions needed for (a) fair customer explanations (billed vs raw tokens, cache attribution) and (b) experiment analysis (cohort/variant attribution). This PR updates the TypeScript SDK to expose those fields in a typed, backwards-compatible way. Changes: (1) Update Usage API response types to include raw token fields and billed token fields (rawPromptTokens/rawCompletionTokens/rawTokensTotal + billedPromptTokens/billedCompletionTokens/billedTokensTotal) and cache attribution (cacheHitTokens when returned by API). (2) Add experiment attribution fields to usage line items: experimentKey, experimentVariant, experimentCohort. These map 1:1 to the API payload when present; when the account/day wasn’t part of an experiment or the server doesn’t emit these dimensions, they remain undefined. (3) Update the usage client deserialization so snake_case API fields map to camelCase SDK fields (e.g., billed_prompt_tokens -> billedPromptTokens). (4) Update docs/snippets in the README for usage exports to call out billed vs raw tokens and the experiment fields as optional dimensions. Example usage: const rows = await client.usage.list({ start: '2026-02-01', end: '2026-02-02', groupBy: ['day','model','region'] }); for (const r of rows.data) { console.log(r.billedTokensTotal, r.rawTokensTotal, r.experimentVariant); } Backwards compatibility: additive only; existing consumers compiling against older fields continue to work. The runtime behavior is unchanged; this is purely surfacing additional fields returned by the API. Testing: added unit tests around usage response parsing (covers missing fields, partial presence, and numeric coercion), and ran the examples against staging with a known experiment account. Notes for rollout: publish as a minor version bump after the server-side Usage API field rollout is at 100% (server is already gated). Links: aligns with the ongoing metering hardening + experiment analysis work (PM-1848) and addresses customer confusion seen in SUP-28451 (invoice vs usage export mismatch) by making billed token fields first-class in the SDK.
commits: feat(usage): add billed token fields to UsageLineItem
feat(usage): add experiment attribution fields to UsageLineItem
fix(usage): map snake_case API fields to camelCase consistently
test(usage): parsing coverage for optional billed/experiment fields
docs: update usage export examples with billed vs raw tokens
review_conversation: Nadia Rahman: Can we be explicit in naming that these are billed tokens vs raw tokens? Also confirm whether billedTokensTotal includes cache-hit tokens or excludes them (depending on pricing rules).

Monica Patel (author): Updated field docs to say billed* comes from the server’s billing meter output; added note that cacheHitTokens is a separate optional field and that billedTokensTotal is authoritative for invoicing. The SDK doesn’t recompute totals.
Logan Wright: Please keep the mapping layer centralized; avoid duplicating snake_case conversion in multiple resources.
Monica Patel (author): Moved mapping to serializers.ts and added a small table-driven test so we don’t regress when new fields are added.
Chris Osei: For experiment analysis, we need cohort/variant fields exposed even if groupBy doesn’t include them (they’ll just be repeated). Does the SDK drop unknown fields today?

Monica Patel (author): SDK already preserves known fields only; added explicit typed fields for experimentKey/Variant/Cohort so they’re accessible regardless of groupBy. Unknown fields are still ignored.
Leila Farouk: Add a test case for ‘older server’ payload with none of these fields to ensure no runtime exceptions.
Monica Patel (author): Added test ‘parses legacy payload’ covering absent fields and ensuring values are undefined.
Nadia Rahman: Approved after doc clarification + serializer refactor.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash; version bump queued for next SDK release train after backend field rollout completes.
